summary.business_type: SaaS: QR code generator with paid dynamic codes (tool-led content site)
top_findings: Canonicals, sitemap and robots.txt point to stayqr.com, which does not serve this site (53/53 pages)
quick_wins: Add llms.txt, favicon.ico, WebSite + Organization schema

findings.title: Canonical and sitemap host mismatch
findings.description: All 53 canonicals, sitemap <loc> URLs and the robots.txt Sitemap line use https://stayqr.com, which resolves to a GoDaddy server and does not answer over HTTPS.
findings.recommendation: Generate absolute URLs from NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL and launch on a domain you control.

findings.title: Missing security headers
findings.description: Only HSTS is sent. No CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy or Permissions-Policy.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Guides of 1,100–1,600 words with tables and FAQs

findings.title: No named authors
findings.description: Guides are credited to the organisation only; the About page names no people.
findings.recommendation: Add a named author/reviewer and an editorial policy page.

findings.title: Industry pages are short
findings.recommendation: Add a worked example and 2–3 FAQs per page.

findings.title: No WebSite/Organization on homepage
findings.recommendation: Add WebSite + Organization to the homepage.

findings.title: No offers markup on pricing
findings.recommendation: Add SoftwareApplication with one Offer per plan.

findings.title: Homepage main-thread cost
findings.description: Lighthouse mobile 83, TBT 412 ms from the 3D hero; LCP 3.13 s.
findings.recommendation: Defer the 3D scene further on mobile.

findings.title: No llms.txt
findings.recommendation: Publish llms.txt listing tools and guides.

findings.title: Weak entity signals
findings.description: No sameAs profiles, no named authors.
findings.recommendation: Add Organization sameAs and author markup.

findings.title: Guides lack og:image
findings.description: 16 guide pages have no og:image because their openGraph override drops the site image.
findings.recommendation: Pass the image explicitly in the guide metadata.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Absolute URLs from NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL; launch on an owned domain

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Landing pages: QR with logo, dynamic QR, app-download QR, bulk QR

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Re-run audit after each content batch
